_meta.source: Shape copied from the real Recruitee sample (src/testdata/recruitee-sample.json — greatminds/thirdway/adams, fetched live 2026-11-19). Company and jobs are fictional (Acme) for the canned test.

offers.description:
This is a fully remote position. Work from anywhere in the United States — remote in all 50 states; no travel or office attendance required.

We are looking for a motivated team member to join our team. You will support customers by phone, email, and chat, and help resolve questions about products and services. This is a full-time position with benefits including health insurance, paid time off, and a 401(k) retirement plan.
offers.requirements: Strong written communication skills and attention to detail are important. Experience with customer support tools is helpful but not required. We provide training and the equipment you need to do the job well.
offers.title: Customer Success Manager

offers.description: This is a hybrid role based in our Chicago office 3 days a week, working from home the other 2 days. You will manage office operations, supplies, and vendor relationships for our Chicago headquarters team.
offers.requirements: Office management experience and strong organizational skills required.
offers.title: Office Manager

offers.description:
This role is based in our Dallas office and warehouse 5 days a week. You will pick, pack, and ship orders, operate a forklift, and keep inventory records accurate for our Dallas distribution team. This is an on-site position; remote work is not available for this role.

Shifts are Monday through Friday, 8am to 5pm, with occasional overtime during peak season. Benefits include health insurance, paid time off, and a 401(k) retirement plan.
offers.requirements: Warehouse experience and a valid forklift certification are preferred. You must be able to lift up to 50 pounds and stand for long periods.
offers.title: Warehouse Associate
